name: Chitine
sourceDistinctions: The 3.5 monster update directs readers to Underdark for the revised Chitine. The older Monsters of Faerûn monster has a different three-weapon routine and sunlight penalty.
The Chitine racial entry grants Multiweapon Fighting. Resolve a full attack with the revised core multiweapon and light off-hand penalties.
Darkvision 60 ft. comes from the Monstrous Humanoid type. Sunlight and bright magical light impose the core dazzled penalties.
Wizards’ collected archive has no Underdark errata file. The official FAQ has no Chitine entry.
portraitForm: Qid Lowweb, an original Chitine Rogue
